metrics.name: ingestion_coverage
metrics.description: Processed and verified source sections divided by total source sections.

metrics.name: dfd_entity_recall
metrics.description: Expected canonical entities found without counting duplicate aliases as new entities.

metrics.name: dfd_precision
metrics.description: Canonical entities, data objects, and flows independently adjudicated as supported by source evidence or an explicit allowed inference, divided by all adjudicated canonical claims. Required-entity recall labels alone cannot measure precision.

metrics.name: duplicate_rate
metrics.description: Semantically duplicate canonical nodes and flows divided by canonical nodes and flows.

metrics.name: topology_validity
metrics.description: Structural endpoint, direction, zone membership, boundary crossing, and connectedness checks divided by all required structural checks. This does not measure whether the documented flow itself is correct.

metrics.name: framework_validation
metrics.description: Framework cases with a validated or legitimate valid-empty assessment divided by framework cases.

metrics.name: finding_precision
metrics.description: Supported expected findings divided by generated findings, measured only from independently adjudicated blind labels. Structural DFD flow binding is a separate diagnostic and cannot satisfy this metric.

metrics.name: finding_recall
metrics.description: Supported expected findings divided by expected findings, measured only from independently adjudicated blind labels. Manifest keyword matching is diagnostic only and cannot satisfy this metric.

metrics.name: deferred_recall
metrics.description: Expected unresolved decisions surfaced as actionable gaps divided by adjudicated expected deferred decisions. Manifest keyword matching is diagnostic only and cannot satisfy this metric.

metrics.name: control_mapping_precision
metrics.description: Independently adjudicated correct finding-to-control edges divided by all adjudicated generated mapping edges. Structural finding-ID binding alone cannot measure semantic correctness.

metrics.name: control_mapping_recall
metrics.description: Independently adjudicated correct finding-to-control edges divided by all independently labeled expected applicable control edges. Generated finding counts alone cannot measure recall.

metrics.name: test_executability
metrics.description: Expected applicable tests that pass the agreed target, mechanism, assertion, evidence, and execution-quality rubric divided by all independently labeled applicable expected tests. Generated scenario count alone cannot measure recall or quality.

rules: A reported percentage without numerator and denominator is legacy context and is never a release metric.
Missing or invalid required metrics fail the gate; they are not treated as zero or one silently.
Framework fallback, timeout, malformed, or truncated output cannot satisfy framework_validation.
A valid-empty framework result requires complete applicable coverage and no failed or deferred interaction.
A metric marked eligible_for_gate=false is diagnostic only and must fail closed even when it has numerator and denominator counts.
Finding precision, finding recall, and deferred recall require independent blind AppSec labels; flow linkage or manifest keyword matching cannot make them gate eligible.

Required-entity labels measure recall only; unlabeled canonical candidates are not false positives. DFD precision must remain not_measured until every candidate entity, data object, and flow has a blinded adjudicated disposition.
Control mapping precision/recall and test executability must fail closed when they use generated records as their own denominator instead of independent expected labels and the agreed review rubric.
The evaluation fingerprint excludes evaluation time and output paths so the same snapshot/config is deterministic.
